people.name: Sukhdev Singh
people.bio: A dedicated freedom fighter and communist activist who fought for the rights of the peasantry in the Begusarai region.

people.name: Navin Kumar Navin
people.bio: A prominent political figure from Bandwar, actively involved in local governance and community development in the Begusarai district.

people.name: Girija Singh
people.bio: A respected village elder who played a key role in building the Shaheed Ramchandra Dwar and was instrumental in the founding and development of the Vaani Vilas Pustakalaya library.
